description: Baseline schema — tables, indexes, and FTS defined in tables.json / indexes.json
Collector model rebuild — drop api_tokens / oauth_clients era objects (destructive)
comment: Drop order matters: FTS triggers reference logs, logs_fts is contentless-backed by logs, and oauth_refresh_tokens / logs hold FKs into the dropped tables. compileSchema() runs again after migrations in database.js#init() and recreates everything with the new column set.

description: OAuth refresh mode — static refresh tokens alongside rotation
comment: SQLite has no ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, and migrations run before the schema DDL — so on a fresh database these tables do not exist yet (compileSchema() creates them complete). 'guardedColumns' introspects first: a missing table is skipped, an existing column is skipped, and only a genuinely missing column is added. 'then' statements run only when every target table exists. Existing OAuth collectors are backfilled to 'rotating', preserving today's behaviour exactly.
then: UPDATE collectors SET oauth_refresh_mode = 'rotating' WHERE auth_method = 'oauth_client_credentials' AND oauth_refresh_mode IS NULL
